h1: Custom PL Workwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom PL workwear for your team. Durable, high-visibility options from Perfect Imprints. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: PL workwear combines professional style with practical safety features, making it a top choice for construction crews, warehouse teams, and field service staff. From hi-vis jackets to durable gloves and caps, these pieces are built for daily wear and easy branding with embroidery or screen printing. Choosing PL ensures your team looks cohesive and stays safe on the job.
heroAltText: Custom PL workwear including hi-vis jackets, safety vests, and caps with company logo
